notes: LCP element: Lighthouse 13.0.1 has no largest-contentful-paint-element audit; selector taken from audits["lcp-breakdown-insight"] node item.
Median lcpElement = element of the run whose LCP equals the median LCP; all per-run selectors are kept in runs[].
scriptTransferSize = audits["resource-summary"] row resourceType=script transferSize (bytes on the wire, gzip enabled).
initialModuleJs = sum of gzip -9 -c over unique <script src="/_next/static/chunks/*.js" async> in the exported HTML, noModule excluded.
Identical protocol to before.json except port 4186 and artifact = worktree out/ (before used port 4185 and the main checkout out/ at 16e4f94).
clsCulprits = node rows of audits["cls-culprits-insight"] (Total row excluded) plus node rows of audits["layout-shifts"].
requestCount = audits["resource-summary"] row resourceType=total requestCount; networkRequestsItemCount = audits["network-requests"].details.items.length.
lenisChunk.requested = any audits["network-requests"] item URL containing /_next/static/chunks/2j9yyl5qtr4km.js (Lenis lazy chunk).
lazyChunksRequested = /_next/static/chunks/*.js requested during the run that are not in the page's initial async module script list.
404 page has no before baseline; included as informational only (no gates).

Gates: perf >= before median; same median LCP element selector; LCP median <= before median + max(5% of before, 50 ms); CLS median <= 0.005 and no culprit selector absent from all 3 before runs; TBT median <= max(10 ms, before median); non-composited-animations 0 items in every run.
